Selective technical forum

GFx™ Architecture Council

A selective technical forum for experienced experts interested in the future of high-speed data transport architecture.

Express InterestReturn to GFx™

Serious technical voices for disciplined architecture thinking.

Mitas is exploring the formation of the GFx™ Architecture Council for experienced technical, research, infrastructure, standards-aware, and industry leaders who can challenge assumptions, add disciplined perspective, and support the evolution of GFx™ thinking.

Participation posture:
The Council is intended to be selective and invitation-oriented. Expressing interest does not guarantee participation, and non-public GFx™ information is not disclosed through this page.
Candidate perspective

Who should be interested.

Infrastructure and Systems Leaders

AI/HPC infrastructure, data-center architecture, advanced computing, and system-scaling professionals who understand physical data movement constraints.

Interconnect and Signal Experts

High-speed interconnect, signal-integrity, RF/mmWave/sub-THz, electromagnetic simulation, photonics, and advanced packaging specialists.

Validation and Transition Advisors

Manufacturing, test, validation, standards-aware, national-lab, government-transition, and commercialization voices with practical technical judgment.

Contribution model

What participants may contribute.

The Council is intended for experienced contributors who can help frame the right questions, review architecture direction, challenge assumptions, improve validation thinking, and add manufacturability or infrastructure perspective as GFx™ continues to evolve.

Architecture perspective and assumption-challenge.
Systems-level insight for future high-speed data transport.
Validation, manufacturability, and transition judgment.
Disciplined technical feedback from qualified experts.
Expression of interest

Express Interest in the GFx™ Architecture Council

Qualified candidates may express interest for consideration. Mitas reviews prospective participants based on expertise, fit, independence, confidentiality readiness, and relevance to GFx™ development priorities.
